config.label: Bearer token for the hosted Spikes API
config.description: Bearer token for the hosted Spikes API. Required only when using --remote mode against spikes.sh. Local mode reads .spikes/feedback.jsonl and needs no token.

config.label: Override the Spikes API base URL
config.description: Override the Spikes API base URL. Defaults to https://spikes.sh/api. Useful for self-hosted Spikes workers.
